name: Mysore Vienna Ashtanga Yoga Shala
reason: Too thin as a school: its own site (mysorevienna.com, robots.txt allows us) is a one-teacher shala run by Barbara Süss (authorised by Sharath Jois in 2016, opened October 2016) in rented rooms at SOMART, Staudgasse 8, 1180 Wien and BIOGENA PLAZA. Every priced item (Mysore passes, drop-in, Active Series card, Saturday introductions on 28.11 and 12.12, all EUR) sits on the single /classes/ page, so only one offering has its own URL; no trainings, retreats or free resources. Email shala@mysorevienna.com is published and the photos are usable. Better as a possible future individual listing for Barbara Süss than as a school.
